propositions: The codebase has 12 packages with untyped defs that are otherwise clean and should be promoted into the disallow_untyped_defs mypy ratchet tier to enforce future compliance.
A second mypy ratchet tier using disallow_any_explicit should be introduced to constrain explicit Any usage, starting with rebar._cli and rebar._snapshot which measure clean under this constraint.
The test_mypy_ratchet.py test must be extended with shrink-only guards for both ratchet tiers to prevent regression.
37 untyped function definitions across 14 files need annotation (return types and parameter types) without introducing new Any declarations.
The mypy ratchet mechanism and two-tier structure must be documented in architecture.md with measured baseline tables showing per-package error counts.
